notes: Posted 16 November 2001, before Theed Palace (12 December 2001), so the format is Premiere - Reflections III; the 'new dark objective' is the Reflections III Let Them Make The First Move.

Starting cards as marked '(starting)' in the list: Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core, Naboo: Theed Palace Generator, Prepared Defenses, Conduct Your Search, Imperial Arrest Order, Mobilization Points, plus the objective and Fear Is My Ally (posted as 'Starting Effect (1)'); these count toward the 60.
Posted 'Lem Them Make the First Move/At Last We Will Have Revenge' (typo) dested the objective Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge.
Naboo Theed Palace Gen Core, Generator, Docking Bay, Endor Back Door and Endor Landing Platform dested the Dark printings of those sites.

Posted 'Maul's Double Stick of Fun' dested Maul's Double-Bladed Lightsaber (the Reflections III saber for Lord Maul); 'Darth Vader DLOTS' Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Mara Jade TEH' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Drop' Drop!; 'Vaders Obsession' Vader's Obsession.

Shields dested the Reflections III Dark Defensive Shield pages Oppressive Enforcement, Come Here You Big Coward, Battle Order, Secret Plans, You Cannot Hide Forever and Fanfare (all '(Dark)' pages), plus You've Never Won A Race?, We'll Let Fate-a Decide, Huh?, Weapon Of A Sith and A Useless Gesture.

Strategy updates (16 and 19 November) say the author had missed the Conduct Your Search errata, that the deck needs an overhaul and asks readers to let the review go by; the list is kept as published.
